object.name: evi.arpnotch~
object.digest: A nonlinear SVF Notch filter which can morph between LP..Notch..HP
object.description: A nonlinear 12dB SVF filter which can smoothly morph between LP..Notch..HP, thus making it a partial emulation of the ARP 1047 filter/resonator. The morphing through notch is resonance-compensated so that the analog notch is always strong.
object.discussion: For more information about other nonlinear SVF filters in evieve, see the 'evieve svf' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.digest: Freq in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on 'cutoffmode' attribute
inlets.description: Cutoff frequency in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.
Resonance 0..1, can self oscillate at '1' depending on current morph factor (inlet 4).

attributes.name: cutoffmode
attributes.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (default on) or Hz (off).

attributes.name: morphsmooth
attributes.description: If morphsmooth > 0, the 'Morph' control (inlet 4) will be internally smoothed by this time. Default off.
